name: skyvern-claude-desktop
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a Skyvern HTTPS deployment using an API key.
long_description: Bundle an API-key bridge for Skyvern Cloud or private HTTPS deployments using the legacy MCP initialize handshake. Configure the deployment key, final MCP URL, and optional PEM CA file. Claude Desktop can supply a compatible built-in Node runtime; the manual CLI route requires system Node. Local browser automation was verified separately; Cloud authentication requires a Cloud key.

api_key.title: Skyvern API Key
api_key.description: API key issued by your Skyvern deployment. A local deployment key can be used without Skyvern Cloud.

server_url.title: Skyvern MCP URL
server_url.description: HTTPS endpoint of your Skyvern deployment. Use the final URL; redirects are refused.

ca_certificate.title: Additional trusted CA certificate (optional)
ca_certificate.description: Absolute path to a PEM CA file for private HTTPS. Leave empty for public certificates. Added to existing trust only in this extension runtime.
